description: Stand aside from a review this participant cannot decide, for example on a conflict of interest or for want of context. Use it in place of chap.decide.reject, which judges the work; abstaining judges nothing and leaves the artefact intact. It requires an open review addressed to the caller and answers -32010 otherwise. The task moves to abstained, which is not terminal: chap.escalate.raise or a fresh chap.review.request can still carry it forward.

category.description: The kind of abstention. Recorded in the audit entry.

reason.description: Why this reviewer is standing aside. Recorded in the audit entry.
